## Planned Analyses

Okay, I've read your advice and I tried my best lol with thinkiing this through.

For this project, I will examine how racial and ethnic representation changed at Big Ten universities between 2014 and 2024.

Percentage-Point Changes

I will subtract each group's 2014 percentage from its 2024 percentage at every university. This will show which groups increased or decreased at each school. I will also compare UMD's changes with those of other Big Ten universities.

 Descriptive Statistics

I will calculate the mean and median percentage-point changes for each racial and ethnic group across the universities. This will help identify overall patterns and show how UMD compares with the rest of the conference.


Charts
I will create line charts to show how each group's representation changed over time. I will also create charts comparing the percentage-point changes across universities.




 Regression Analysis

I may use regression analysis to examine how each group's representation changed over time and whether there was an overall upward or downward trend.

## Examining the Data

Looking at the dataset there are 1,980 rows and 5 columns. It includes undergraduate enrollment information for 18 universities from 2014 through 2024.

I want to look at the schools, years, and racial and ethnic groups included in the dataset.

```{r}
# Look at the schools
unique(enrollment$school)

# Look at the years
unique(enrollment$year)

unique(enrollment$race)
```

## Counting the Data

I also want to see how many records are included for each school and racial and ethnic group.

```{r}

count(enrollment, school)

# Count records for each racial and ethnic group

```

## Important Columns

The columns that will be most important for my project are:

school: The name of each university.
race:  The racial or ethnic group being reported.
year: The year the enrollment data was collected.
percent: The percentage of undergraduate students in each group.
unit_id: The identification number for each university.

I will mainly use school, race, year, and percent to compare enrollment changes between UMD and the other universities.

## Planned Analyses


I plan to calculate the percentage-point changes in racial and ethnic representation at Big Ten universities between 2014 and 2024. I will use the mean and median to examine the average changes across universities and compare UMD's results with other Big Ten schools. I also plan to rank the universities for each racial and ethnic group and create bar charts to visualize the changes. These analyses will help me identify which groups experienced the largest increases or decreases in representation.


```{r}
enrollment <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwillis/jour405/refs/heads/main/data/big_ten_enrollment_long.csv")
```

```{r}
unique(enrollment$race)
```
```{r}
group_data <- subset(enrollment,
  race == "Asian/Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander" |
  race == "Black or African American" |
  race == "Hispanic/Latino"
)

head(group_data)
```


```{r}
changes <- group_data %>%
  select(school, race, year, percent) %>%
  filter(year == 2014 | year == 2024) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = percent
  )

changes$change <- changes$`2024` - changes$`2014`

changes

```

```{r}
changes %>%
  group_by(race) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_change = mean(change, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_change = median(change, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(group_data, aes(x = year, y = percent, color = school)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~race) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Racial and Ethnic Diversity at Big Ten Universities",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(changes, aes(x = reorder(school, change), y = change)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~race, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage-Point Changes by University, 2014-2024",
    x = "University",
    y = "Percentage-point change"
  )
```
# Summary

For this project, I examined how racial and ethnic representation changed at Big Ten universities from 2014 to 2024.I tried to follow your advice, I calculated the percentage-point changes for each group at every school. I also calculated the mean and median to compare changes across universities, giving each school equal weight. I looked at how UMD compared with the other Big Ten schools. I created line charts to show changes over time and bar charts to compare schools. These analyses will help me understand the overall changes in racial and ethnic diversity across the Big Ten.
